newsitem.title: USA: Interpublic starts sports marketing group.
newsitem.headline: Interpublic starts sports marketing group.

text.p: Advertising giant Interpublic Group of Companies Inc. said Monday it has acquired two privately held sports marketing firms, which will form the basis of a new sports marketing group within the agency.

The New York-based parent of McCann Erickson Worldwide and Ammirati Puris Lintas said it bought Advantage International in Washington, D.C., and a majority stake in the API Group of Companies, based in London.
Terms of the transactions were not disclosed.
According to Interpublic, Advantage and API represent more than 100 blue-chip international companies and work for, or closely with, almost every major sports federation and broadcaster in the world.
Combined, the acquired companies have initial billings of around $550 million and annual revenue over $50 million.
Interpublic has billings of $20 billion. Its revenues were $2.5 billion in 1996.
The two companies will retain their separate identities and be run by their current management teams. Interpublic said that it expects to consider a full merger later on.
Interpublic stock was up 37.5 cents to $59.25 on the New York Stock Exchange in afternoon trade.
